```{r}
clean_graph_name <- function(x) {
  x <- basename(x)
  x <- gsub("\\.stats$", "", x)
  x <- gsub("\\.full\\.panacus-hist\\.tsv$", "", x)
  x <- gsub("\\.full$", "", x)
  
  x <- gsub("^DMP$", "DMP", x)
  x <- gsub("^Founder$", "Founder", x)
  x <- gsub("^Yu-T2T_v2-refs_Keane-T2T_v3-founders$", "Founder", x)
  
  return(x)
}

load_vg_stats <- function(stats_dir, file_name) {
  file_path <- file.path(stats_dir, file_name)
  
  print(file_path)
  
  if (!file.exists(file_path)) {
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  data <- fread(file_path, header = FALSE, fill = TRUE)
  data$graph <- clean_graph_name(stats_dir)
  data$source_file <- file_name
  
  return(data)
}

load_degree_stats <- function(stats_dir) {
  degree_file <- list.files(
    stats_dir,
    pattern = "^stats__degree_distribution__.*\\.txt$",
    full.names = TRUE
  )
  
  if (length(degree_file) == 0) {
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  if (length(degree_file) > 1) {
    stop(paste0("More than one degree distribution file found in: ", stats_dir))
  }
  
  print(degree_file)
  
  data <- fread(degree_file, header = TRUE, fill = TRUE)
  
  degree_graph <- basename(degree_file)
  degree_graph <- gsub("^stats__degree_distribution__", "", degree_graph)
  degree_graph <- gsub("\\.txt$", "", degree_graph)
  degree_graph <- clean_graph_name(degree_graph)
  
  if (!"Degree" %in% colnames(data)) {
    colnames(data)[1] <- "Degree"
  }
  
  node_count_column <- grep("Nodes.*total|Nodes.total|nodes.*total|nodes", colnames(data), value = TRUE)[1]
  
  if (is.na(node_count_column)) {
    node_count_column <- setdiff(colnames(data), "Degree")[1]
  }
  
  colnames(data)[colnames(data) == node_count_column] <- "Nodes.total."
  
  data$Degree <- as.numeric(data$Degree)
  data$Nodes.total. <- as.numeric(data$Nodes.total.)
  data$graph <- degree_graph
  data$source_file <- basename(degree_file)
  
  return(data)
}

load_panacus_stats <- function(file_name) {
  print(file_name)
  
  raw_lines <- readLines(file_name)
  
  raw_lines <- raw_lines[!grepl("^\\s*$", raw_lines)]
  raw_lines <- raw_lines[!grepl("^\\s*#", raw_lines)]
  
  parsed_rows <- lapply(raw_lines, function(x) {
    numeric_values <- regmatches(
      x,
      gregexpr("[-+]?[0-9]*\\.?[0-9]+([eE][-+]?[0-9]+)?", x)
    )[[1]]
    
    if (length(numeric_values) < 2) {
      return(NULL)
    }
    
    data.frame(
      assemblies = as.numeric(numeric_values[1]),
      count = as.numeric(numeric_values[2])
    )
  })
  
  data <- bind_rows(parsed_rows)
  
  if (nrow(data) == 0) {
    stop(paste0("No numeric panacus rows were parsed from: ", file_name))
  }
  
  data$graph <- clean_graph_name(file_name)
  
  return(data)
}
```

```{r}
stats_dirs <- list.dirs("vg_stats", recursive = FALSE, full.names = TRUE)

  load_vg_stats(stats_dir, "graph-stats.tsv")
}) %>% bind_rows()

  load_vg_stats(stats_dir, "sample-stats.tsv")
}) %>% bind_rows()

}) %>% bind_rows()
```

```{r}
as.numeric(panacus_dataframe$count) -> panacus_dataframe$count
as.numeric(panacus_dataframe$assemblies) -> panacus_dataframe$assemblies

print("Nonzero panacus ranges by graph:")
panacus_dataframe %>%
  filter(count != 0) %>%
  group_by(graph) %>%
  summarize(
    min_assemblies = min(assemblies),
    max_assemblies = max(assemblies),
    n_nonzero_bins = n(),
    total_count = sum(count),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  print()

# Remove hardcoded/padded Panacus bins with zero counts.
panacus_dataframe <- panacus_dataframe[panacus_dataframe$count != 0,]

# Sort before cumulative calculations.
panacus_dataframe <- panacus_dataframe[order(panacus_dataframe$graph, panacus_dataframe$assemblies),]

panacus_dataframe$percentage <- NA
panacus_dataframe$cumulative <- NA
panacus_dataframe$Percent.assemblies <- NA

for (GRAPH in unique(panacus_dataframe$graph)) {
  panacus_dataframe[panacus_dataframe$graph == GRAPH,]$percentage <-
    panacus_dataframe[panacus_dataframe$graph == GRAPH,]$count /
    sum(panacus_dataframe[panacus_dataframe$graph == GRAPH,]$count) * 100
  
  panacus_dataframe[panacus_dataframe$graph == GRAPH,]$cumulative <-
    cumsum(panacus_dataframe[panacus_dataframe$graph == GRAPH,]$percentage)
  
  panacus_dataframe[panacus_dataframe$graph == GRAPH,]$Percent.assemblies <-
    panacus_dataframe[panacus_dataframe$graph == GRAPH,]$assemblies /
    max(panacus_dataframe[panacus_dataframe$graph == GRAPH,]$assemblies)
}

row.names(panacus_dataframe) <- NULL
```

```{r}
# Summarize graph-level stats across chromosomes.
graph_stats_summary_dataframe <- graph_stats_dataframe %>%
  group_by(graph, graph_group, statistic) %>%
  summarize(
    total_value = sum(value, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Summarize sample stats across chromosomes.
sample_stats_summary_dataframe <- sample_stats_dataframe %>%
  group_by(graph, graph_group, sample) %>%
  summarize(
    total_value = sum(value, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Parse path names into sample / haplotype / path chromosome / interval fields.
path_name_parts <- strsplit(as.character(path_stats_dataframe$path), "#", fixed = TRUE)

path_stats_dataframe$path_sample <- sapply(path_name_parts, function(x) {
  if (length(x) >= 1) x[1] else NA
})

path_stats_dataframe$path_haplotype <- sapply(path_name_parts, function(x) {
  if (length(x) >= 2) x[2] else NA
})

path_stats_dataframe$path_chrom <- sapply(path_name_parts, function(x) {
  if (length(x) >= 3) x[3] else NA
})

path_stats_dataframe$path_interval <- sapply(path_name_parts, function(x) {
  if (length(x) >= 4) x[4] else NA
})

# Summarize path stats by parsed sample and haplotype.
path_stats_summary_dataframe <- path_stats_dataframe %>%
  group_by(graph, graph_group, path_sample, path_haplotype) %>%
  summarize(
    total_value = sum(value, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_paths = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Parse clip-stats.bed conservatively.
clip_stat_columns <- setdiff(colnames(clip_stats_dataframe), c("graph", "source_file", "graph_group"))

colnames(clip_stats_dataframe)[colnames(clip_stats_dataframe) == clip_stat_columns[1]] <- "chrom"
colnames(clip_stats_dataframe)[colnames(clip_stats_dataframe) == clip_stat_columns[2]] <- "start"
colnames(clip_stats_dataframe)[colnames(clip_stats_dataframe) == clip_stat_columns[3]] <- "end"

if (length(clip_stat_columns) >= 4) {
  colnames(clip_stats_dataframe)[colnames(clip_stats_dataframe) == clip_stat_columns[4]] <- "clip_name"
}

if (length(clip_stat_columns) >= 5) {
  colnames(clip_stats_dataframe)[colnames(clip_stats_dataframe) == clip_stat_columns[5]] <- "clip_value"
}

clip_stats_dataframe$start <- as.numeric(clip_stats_dataframe$start)
clip_stats_dataframe$end <- as.numeric(clip_stats_dataframe$end)
clip_stats_dataframe$width <- clip_stats_dataframe$end - clip_stats_dataframe$start

clip_stats_summary_dataframe <- clip_stats_dataframe %>%
  group_by(graph, graph_group) %>%
  summarize(
    n_clip_intervals = n(),
    total_clip_bp = sum(width, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_clip_width = mean(width, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_clip_width = median(width, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

print("graph_stats_summary_dataframe")
print(graph_stats_summary_dataframe)

print("sample_stats_summary_dataframe")
print(head(sample_stats_summary_dataframe))

print("path_stats_summary_dataframe")
print(head(path_stats_summary_dataframe))

print("clip_stats_summary_dataframe")
print(clip_stats_summary_dataframe)
```

```{r}
graph_stats_plot_dataframe <- graph_stats_summary_dataframe

p_graph_stats <- ggplot(
  subset(graph_stats_plot_dataframe, statistic != "length" ),
  aes(y = statistic, x = total_value / 1000000, fill = graph)
) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "dodge") +
  scale_x_continuous(
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.10))
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = GRAPH_COLORS) +
  theme_cowplot() +
  labs(y = NULL, x = "Number (millions)") +
  theme(
    legend.position = "top",
    legend.title = element_blank(),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 8),
    legend.key.size = unit(0.4, "cm"),
    legend.key.height = unit(0.25, "cm"),
    legend.spacing.x = unit(0.05, "cm"),
    legend.spacing.y = unit(0.01, "cm")
  )

p_graph_stats

ggsave("graph_stats_summary_DMP_Founder.png", p_graph_stats, width = 8, height = 4, dpi = 600)
ggsave("graph_stats_summary_DMP_Founder.svg", p_graph_stats, width = 8, height = 4)
```

```{r}
p_degree <- ggplot(
  degree_dataframe,
  aes(x = Degree, y = Nodes.total. / 1000000, fill = graph)
) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "dodge") +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = seq(0, max(degree_dataframe$Degree, na.rm = TRUE), 5),
    expand = c(0, 0)
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 1.1 * max(degree_dataframe$Nodes.total., na.rm = TRUE) / 1000000),
    expand = c(0, 0)
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = GRAPH_COLORS) +
  theme_cowplot() +
  labs(x = "Degree", y = "Nodes (millions)") +
  theme(legend.position = "none") +
  ggbreak::scale_y_break(c(3, 5, 15, 16), scales = 0.5) +
  theme(
    axis.ticks.y.right = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y.right = element_blank(),
    axis.line.y.right = element_blank()
  )

p_degree

ggsave("degree_distribution_DMP_Founder.png", p_degree, width = 8, height = 4, dpi = 600)
```
